_notes: The Broodspiral boss + named-rare loot (rebuilt 2026-10-21; the old pool used the invalid slot 'weapon'). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make). The gun carries Healing Power on purpose (wide CoA weapon spread).

Carapace Warden.name: Cracked Carapace Mantle
Carapace Warden.flavor_text: Plates of shell the Warden shed, strapped over soft hide. They still ring when struck.

Carapace Warden.name: Warden's Chitin Bands
Carapace Warden.flavor_text: Bands of pale chitin sewn onto cloth. They hum faintly, as if the hive were listening.

Carapace Warden.name: Burrower's Girdle
Carapace Warden.flavor_text: Links of chitin and old mail, built for something that spends its life underground.

Carapace Warden.name: Carapace-Splitter
Carapace Warden.flavor_text: A short axe with a head ground from the Warden's own claw. It finishes what the claw started.

The Broodkeeper.name: Broodkeeper's Vestments
The Broodkeeper.flavor_text: Silk spun by something that was not meant to be spun by. Wounds mend faster under it, and so does the dread.

The Broodkeeper.name: Caustic-Woven Leggings
The Broodkeeper.flavor_text: Woven with acid-treated thread. They resist everything, including being washed.

The Broodkeeper.name: Chitinguard Gauntlets
The Broodkeeper.flavor_text: Heavy chitin gauntlets, still faintly warm from the brood they guarded.

The Broodkeeper.name: Keeper's Brood-Crook
The Broodkeeper.flavor_text: A shepherd's crook for a flock of larvae. It hums when something nearby is hungry.

Larval Broodguard.name: Venomspitter Rifle
Larval Broodguard.flavor_text: A rifle that fires a mist of larval venom. Strangely, it heals the friendlies it misses.

Larval Broodguard.name: Screenwarden's Helm
Larval Broodguard.flavor_text: A helm of mail and chitin, built to hold the line against things that bite.

Larval Broodguard.name: Broodguard's Signet
Larval Broodguard.flavor_text: A ring of larval amber. It warms when you heal and cools when you stop.

Larval Broodguard.name: Larval Shell Buckler
Larval Broodguard.flavor_text: A shield cut from a molted larval shell. It remembers every blow, and returns a few.

Broodspiral Queen.name: Queen's Bulwark
Broodspiral Queen.flavor_text: Plate grown, not forged, over a queen's own carapace. It is very hard to leave the hive in it.

Broodspiral Queen.name: Hivemind Legguards
Broodspiral Queen.flavor_text: Layered chitin, linked by something that thinks. It occasionally finishes your sentences.

Broodspiral Queen.name: Queenmother's Mace
Broodspiral Queen.flavor_text: A mace carved from the queen's own mandible. It is heavy, and it is unfriendly.

Broodspiral Queen.name: Broodspiral Cloak
Broodspiral Queen.flavor_text: A cloak of pale silk drawn from the queen's own spinnerets. It soothes you, and it watches.

Mother Amberwing.name: Egg-Guard Bracers
Mother Amberwing.flavor_text: Chitin bracers lined with egg-membrane. They keep a person's pulse low and their guard high.

Mother Amberwing.name: Amber-Drop Pendant
Mother Amberwing.flavor_text: A tear of hard amber on a cord. Something inside is very still, very patient.

Mother Amberwing.name: Brood-Mother's Stinger
Mother Amberwing.flavor_text: A short stinger set in a bone grip. It's faster than it looks and meaner than it should be.

Gnash the Hollow-Maw.name: Gnash's Hollow-Tusk Cleaver
Gnash the Hollow-Maw.flavor_text: A broad axe built around a split tusk. It hungers, in the way that tusks do.

Gnash the Hollow-Maw.name: Maw-Hide Jerkin
Gnash the Hollow-Maw.flavor_text: Tough hide from the pit, rough-cured and rank. It laughs at claws.

Gnash the Hollow-Maw.name: Marrow-Cracker Band
Gnash the Hollow-Maw.flavor_text: A band of bone-iron, scarred by a hundred knuckle-cracks. It doesn't mind.

Gnash the Hollow-Maw.name: Treatise on Unhelpful Doors
Gnash the Hollow-Maw.flavor_text: Nine chapters. The doors remain unhelpful.
Gnash the Hollow-Maw.label: Tome (Int)

Gnash the Hollow-Maw.name: Brood-Barbed Dart
Gnash the Hollow-Maw.flavor_text: The barb is a leg. It is still articulated.
Gnash the Hollow-Maw.label: Thrown (Agi)

Chitterlord Skrix.name: Skrix's Chitter-Rod
Chitterlord Skrix.flavor_text: A slender rod of resin that clicks and chitters when you aim it. Loudly.

Chitterlord Skrix.name: Swarm-Lord's Mantle
Chitterlord Skrix.flavor_text: A mantle of tiny shell-plates. Each one moves a little. Don't look at it for long.

Chitterlord Skrix.name: Veil of a Thousand Legs
Chitterlord Skrix.flavor_text: A cloak of fine chitin-silk. It prickles. It is very, very warm.
